summary: Rocket Lab filed a routine Form 8-K under Items 7.01, 8.01 and 9.01 disclosing an operational update on its Neutron launch vehicle rather than any special-situation transaction. The company announced its first Neutron launch is now expected in 2027, shifted from the prior target, as development and process improvements continue, with key manufacturing and testing milestones still ahead. A press release and investor presentation were furnished. No financial terms, board recommendation, advisor, or transaction mechanics are present, so no risk-arb angle applies; the filing is a product-program disclosure.
